title: Old release lines linger: 40% of 2025 MaxQuant deposits ran 1.6, first seen eight years earlier
sub:
Share of PRIDE datasets recording each software release line, by submission year (datasets released 2013–2025). Versions are read from deposited
parameter files, logs and workflows (MaxQuant, DIA-NN, FragPipe) or mzIdentML writer fields (Proteome Discoverer). Black triangles: a second
contributor group first records the line in PRIDE. Grey numbers: datasets with a version. 2025 coverage: MaxQuant 361 of 576 datasets
naming the tool, Proteome Discoverer 112 of 486, DIA-NN 110 of 331, FragPipe 45 of 142.
notes: a–d: submission (deposit) year on one time scale; 2025 = submissions public by 31 Dec 2025. e: 95% group-bootstrap intervals over hashed contributor groups.
